This fixture is the Virgil glossary and generated GLOSSARY.md at local
`origin/main` commit `aece0f5ee1f1f1367b6805a2d45457868533b0d5` in the Virgil repository.
`references.json` records the rule, principle and referenced document IDs
present at that revision. The test checks the original 83 terms without
requiring a Virgil checkout or a network connection.
